_about: What a device does with a Drive copy of generation `found` when the highest it has accepted is `seen`: refuse it, or take it and write the next copy as generation `next`. The app (generationStep in lib/sync/sync_engine.dart) and the extension (extension/src/vault/rollback.js) must both give these answers.

cases.why: a first sync, or a file from before the counter
a device that never synced takes whatever is there
the copy this device last saw
from before the counter, after it existed
taken on purpose: written above everything seen, so no device refuses it
